pick.name: Reclaim.ai (Lite)
pick.what: AI calendar layer that auto-schedules focus time, habits and buffers and syncs personal<->work calendars
pick.why: Free tier supports Outlook and Google together, so it can block company calendar time for personal commitments and protect focus time automatically
pick.free_limits: Lite: 2 connected calendars, 1 calendar sync, 1-week scheduling range, 1 scheduling link, 5 AI agents; Todoist/Linear integrations need Starter ($10/seat/mo annual)

alts.name: Notion Calendar
alts.what: Free calendar app showing Google, Outlook and iCloud calendars together
alts.why: Best free unified view for manual time blocking; Outlook support added June 2026; Windows + Android apps
alts.install: web or Windows app from notion.com/product/calendar

alts.name: Morgen
alts.what: Calendar + task time-blocking planner (Google, Outlook, iCloud, CalDAV)
alts.why: Best pay-later planner if you want tasks dragged onto a multi-account calendar

candidates.name: Reclaim.ai Lite
candidates.verdict: PICK: free automatic focus/habit blocking + cross-account sync

candidates.name: Notion Calendar
candidates.verdict: Free manual unified view; no automation

candidates.name: Outlook/Gmail native
candidates.verdict: Can overlay calendars but no automatic blocking

decision: Reclaim Lite is the only free option that both auto-protects focus time and syncs personal Google events into the company Outlook calendar. If company Entra ID blocks third-party calendar consent, fall back to Notion Calendar (free, manual) and block time by hand. Upgrade to Reclaim Starter only if you need Todoist/Linear task scheduling.
details: Connecting a company M365 calendar to a third-party app may need tenant admin consent (needs_company=unclear).

verify.note: Reclaim Lite confirmed: 2 connected calendars across Google & Outlook, 1 calendar sync, 1-week range, 1 scheduling link, 5 AI agents; Todoist/Linear etc. need paid; Starter $10/seat/mo yearly ($12 monthly). Linking a company M365 calendar may still need Entra admin consent / company policy.
